description: Get a single Canvas user by numeric ID, returning the full Canvas user object (name, email, login_id, time_zone, bio, pronouns) when the caller is permitted to see it. Use get_profile instead when the target is the caller's own account, search_users to find a user when you only know their name, login, or email in an account, or list_course_users to see every user enrolled in a specific course. Because a bare ID lookup carries no enrollment data, pseudonymized mode cannot tell staff from students here and conservatively anonymizes the name and email on every call; list_course_users only keeps a real name when it is also called with `include: ["enrollments"]` and Canvas reports a teacher, TA, or designer enrollment for that user.
name: get_user
title: Get User
